regime_context: The Ontario energy/materials complex (Oil & Gas, base metals, uranium) shows the highest raw momentum scores but is gated ineligible on weak durability, leaving Big Banks as the effective eligible leader with a strong trend/durability profile and wide breadth. The leadership margin is narrowing (0.44 eligible breadth, 0.32 absorption) and no single narrative dominates, so the detector state supports a cautious, trend-gated read focused on durable Financials/defensives rather than any high-conviction directional call.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Uranium & Nuclear (currently rank 16, score -2.513, ineligible) stabilizes its durability bar above 0.3 and breadth above 0.5 — that would signal the extreme energy/materials underperformance is reversing; if durability stays below 0.2 for the next 10 sessions, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the highest-ranked eligible theme with a durability bar of 0.8, a 'trend' Hurst tag, full breadth (1.0), and a crowding z of 0.61 (not crowded). The absolute-trend gate (the one validated edge for drawdown control) supports staying with this theme, and it is the challenger with the strongest eligible rank. The lean is a durability-based stay, not a momentum chase.
theses.dissent: Big Banks is the headline theme with weight 0.25 and is heavily represented in the benchmark; its relative strength may be crowded in benchmark terms and the challenger margin over Oil & Gas is modest (0.225), so a leadership handoff away from Financials could stall it without warning.
